title: Kusanagi Nene — The Gap Is Laid Bare〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: The Phoenix in the Distant Sky

rows.Line: Early morning
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: *Yawn* Morning, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hello, Nene.
Thank you for meeting with me so early.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Actually, it's okay since I was planning to practice on my own this morning...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, what is it that you wanna talk about?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, remember how we agreed to help Tsukasa figure out his character?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: To be honest, getting on the same level as Seiryuin as she is now will be incredibly difficult...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But you still wish to go through with this regardless...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I was totally blown away by Seiryuin's performance...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Tsukasa felt the same way... No, he's been practicing opposite her, so he must feel the skill gap even more clearly.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But he still refuses to give up...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, what do you need me to do?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It's simple.
However, what I'm about to ask of you is likely not going to be easy.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I built this Robo-Phoenix based on the bird robots I made for one of our shows. I'd like you to help me bring her to life.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Bring it to life...?
Wait, that thing's huge!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The birds for that show fit in the palm of your hand. This one's at least three times as big!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. She should make for a good practice partner in terms of chasing a phoenix around.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I made this one bigger and reinforced her quite a bit so that a person can physically grab onto her.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
And don't underestimate her.
After replacing the parts with more lightweight ones and optimizing her performance, she can do significantly more compared to her predecessors.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I've even programmed a new algorithm that should make it much harder to catch her.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, what do you need me to do exactly? You said you wanted me to help you bring it to life...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'd like for you to play the phoenix, Nene. I need to take some recordings for Robo-Phoenix.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, me...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Simple, no?
But difficult at the same time.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Me...? Playing the phoenix...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I can't do what she did...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
O-Okay, I'll give it a try...
I mean, I did promise to help.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you. I appreciate it...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “How does what feel...?”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This is how I imagine the phoenix...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“I think nothing of it.
I have long since gotten used to all that...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I feel like I'm capturing how she really feels...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But is this gonna be good enough...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Nicely done, Nene.
Robo-Phoenix should be ready to use during practice later today.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sure, you're welcome...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Anyway, now that we've finished recording... Oh!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Hey, she's moving on her own...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What have I done...?! I was trying to play back the recordings, but powered her on instead!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, Nene.
Could you help me try to catch her?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Alright, fine...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene, she went that way!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Got her!
No, she flew away...!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Phoenix
rows.Line:
“Oh, done already...?
You sounded so confident about catching me just now.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Wait, that line...)

rows.Speaker: Robo-Phoenix
rows.Line:
“Too slow.
Honestly, where are you looking? Are you not going to catch me?”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I sorta feel compelled to keep trying...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(But it's not her...
All I'm hearing is a person talking.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (As I currently am... I can't do what she can...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I should at least try to sound more like a phoenix by doing what I can to capture how a bird moves and behaves...!)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, that reminds me! I can send her a signal to stop in case of emergencies! There we are.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? How can you forget about something like...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(No, wait... He wouldn't...
That means he powered her on to...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Sorry, Rui.
Would you mind if we rerecorded everything?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm not happy at all with my portrayal of her. What we have right now isn't going to help Tsukasa much.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Of course I don't mind.
We can keep trying until you feel satisfied.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks...!
